rules.name: Numerical consistency
rules.body: The executed Python drives grids and traces as well as training.

dos: Preserve the university asset and exact instructor credit.
Keep settings relevant to the selected model.
donts: Do not replace the course identity.
Do not animate a separate mathematical model.
Do not autoplay the forward sequence.
